transpose.title: Transpose
transpose.description: Transposes notes in the selected singing clips or the selected notes by a number of semitones.
transpose.selectionWarning: Select one or more singing clips or one or more notes.
transpose.rangeWarning: At least one note would be outside the valid key range from 0 through 127 after transposition.
transpose.formDescription: Enter the number of semitones to shift each note. Use a negative value to transpose down.
